name: evercraft-ai-suite
description: Discover the smallest truthful Evercraft capability for a user problem, invoke public tools where appropriate, and continue into human-confirmed commerce.

interface.shortDescription: Match a real problem to an Evercraft capability
interface.longDescription: Use Evercraft AI Suite as a pain-first front door to discover the smallest relevant Evercraft capability, inspect truthful public offers, invoke bounded tools, and prepare human-confirmed paid continuations without exposing private topology or silently creating payment obligations.
defaultPrompt: I have a problem and do not know which Evercraft capability fits. Find the smallest useful option, explain why it fits, and only show a paid continuation if I ask to proceed.
